name: Plnge
tagline: Enterprise cold-plunge recovery, metered by the minute.
positioning: Plnge operates on-site cold-plunge studios for large employers and campuses, billing only for immersion minutes actually used — with facility telemetry, safety logs, and utilization reporting your HR and facilities teams can audit.

hero.h1: Cold-plunge recovery your whole workforce can actually book.
hero.sub: Plnge builds, staffs, and monitors on-site cold-plunge studios for enterprises — then bills you only for the immersion minutes your people use. No idle-tub overhead, no per-seat guessing.

features.title: Metered immersion, not flat rent
features.description: Every plunge is logged by badge tap and water sensor. You pay for verified immersion minutes — the same line item shows up in your facilities ledger and our invoice.

features.title: Temperature and safety telemetry
features.description: Each tub streams water temperature, dwell time, and occupancy to a dashboard your EHS team can export. Incident flags and cooldown logs are retained for seven years.

features.title: Utilization reporting for HR
features.description: See adoption by building, shift, and department without touching PII. Roll it into your wellness ROI deck with a single export.

features.title: Staffed or self-serve modes
features.description: Run attended sessions during peak hours and badge-gated self-serve overnight. Plnge attendants are trained and insured under our master policy.

features.title: Multi-site standardization
features.description: Deploy identical studios across campuses so a plunge in Austin feels like a plunge in Rotterdam — same protocols, same sensors, same invoice format.

features.title: Facilities-friendly install
features.description: Skid-mounted chillers, sealed drainage, and a documented load spec your building engineers sign off on before the first fill.

testimonials.quote: We stopped paying for tubs nobody used. Plnge's per-minute billing dropped our recovery spend 34% while adoption actually went up across three plants.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: The EHS telemetry sealed it for us. Every dwell time and cooldown is logged, so our safety review took an afternoon instead of a quarter.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Standardizing plunge protocols across six campuses used to be impossible. Now every site invoices the same way and reports the same metrics.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

homepage.footerBlurb: Plnge designs, staffs, and meters on-site cold-plunge studios for enterprise employers — so recovery is a measurable utility, not a sunk cost.
